prompts.title: Modern Editorial Collage Poster Design
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic luxury fashion editorial collage in a vertical 2:3 composition.
A beautiful young woman stands confidently on the left side against a warm beige minimalist wall. Show her nearly full body with comfortable headroom and natural proportions. She wears an oversized soft-pink sweater, baggy distressed light-wash jeans, and pink sneakers. Her hair has a smooth center part and falls naturally over one shoulder. Minimal natural makeup, realistic radiant skin, soft pink lips, defined brows, and a gentle warm smile.
Pose: both hands casually inside her jean pockets, with one leg naturally crossed in front of the other. Relaxed, graceful, confident fashion-editorial body language.
Behind her, place a premium matte-taupe 3D cursive wall sign reading exactly “Alice”, with a thin horizontal underline ending in a small heart. The lettering should be clean, elegant, clearly readable, and physically mounted on the wall.
On the right side, create three evenly sized monochrome close-up portrait panels, stacked vertically with some space between them, each surrounded by a thin, soft-pink border. All three panels must show the same woman as the main portrait, wearing stylish black sunglasses:
Top: looking confidently toward the camera.
Middle: looking downward while gently touching her hair.
Bottom: adjusting her sunglasses while gazing into the distance.
Keep the three panels precisely aligned with equal spacing and consistent scale.
Soft warm golden-hour sunlight enters from one side, creating elegant diagonal foliage shadows across the beige wall. Place a large matte stone planter with a delicate cherry blossom tree in the lower-left corner without obstructing the woman.
Color palette: warm beige, cream, ivory, matte taupe, and soft pink. Clean Scandinavian minimalism combined with premium lifestyle fashion-editorial styling.
Photorealistic skin texture, natural pores, individually detailed hair strands, realistic fabric folds and denim texture, accurate anatomy, soft dimensional shadows, controlled highlights, subtle depth of field, crisp facial detail, natural color grading, premium editorial photography.
Main portrait photographed with an elegant full-body fashion perspective; side panels resemble refined 85mm portrait close-ups. Clean balanced composition, realistic natural lighting, high-end magazine campaign quality, ultra-photorealistic, high detail.
Aspect ratio: 2:3.

prompts.title: Large 3D Name Sign Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium, ultra-realistic full-body studio fashion portrait of the uploaded man, preserving his natural facial identity, skin tone, age, hairstyle and existing facial hair. Dress him in a relaxed deep chocolate-brown button-down shirt made from soft brushed cotton with an open collar, rolled sleeves and natural folds, paired with tapered black trousers, clean white low-top sneakers, black rectangular sunglasses and a silver wristwatch. Position him closely beside the installation with relaxed shoulders, ankles casually crossed, one hand inside his trouser pocket and the other holding a second pair of thin-framed sunglasses near his waist. His body faces slightly toward the camera while his head turns naturally toward camera right with a calm, confident expression.
To his left, place separate oversized three-dimensional letters vertically stacked in open space, spelling “NAME” exactly from top to bottom. Each letter must have a smooth, continuous warm-white illuminated front face with thick black extruded sides, supported invisibly above a minimal black floor base. Do not use a backing panel, frame, column or visible marquee bulbs. Make the complete letter installation approximately the same height as the subject.
Use a seamless deep-black studio background and dark reflective floor. Let the illuminated letters act as the dominant warm side light, casting a soft amber glow across the subject, outlining his clothing and creating a concentrated reflection beneath the installation. Add only subtle frontal fill to preserve natural facial detail and rich shadows. Eye-level 50mm perspective, realistic proportions, cinematic low-key editorial photography, clean composition without additional text or logos, 4:5 or 3:4 aspect ratio. Letters vertically stacked, No gap between the letters.

prompts.title: Boy Standing Next to 3D Name
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the subject’s face and identity reference. 
Create a premium photorealistic full-body studio fashion portrait of the stylish man in a vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Place the subject slightly left of center, large in frame, with very little empty space above the head and only a small amount of floor visible below.
Pose: both hands in jogger pockets, relaxed stance, one leg slightly crossed forward with one heel raised. Soft eye contact with confident expression.
Dress him in a deep burgundy / wine-maroon oversized co-ord set: a loose oversized sweatshirt and relaxed joggers with heavy cotton texture, soft drape, and rich folds. Sleeves should be scrunched to the forearms. Include visible jogger drawstrings, clean white low-top sneakers, and a subtle smartwatch.
On the right side, place huge freestanding sculptural 3D block Capital letters spelling “Rock,” arranged vertically with one letter stacked above the next, forming a bold design column close to the subject. The letters should feel like heavy architectural objects and may have slight rotation or tilt for a more natural stacked installation look, but must remain clearly readable. Use bright silver-white front faces, darker gray side faces, crisp edges, deep extrusion, and a premium matte-satin finish.
Use a dark charcoal-gray seamless studio background with a soft matte gray floor. The backdrop must look fully seamless, with no visible corners or room edges. Both the subject and the 3D letters should appear placed close to the background wall, with visible soft shadows falling behind them, especially behind the text. Add only a very subtle floor reflection.
Use bright, clean, premium studio lighting with soft frontal light and a gentle upper-left key light. Keep the outfit color rich and vibrant, the face and outfit crisp, and the letters cleanly highlighted. Avoid dull tones, blue cast, heavy glow, or overly dark cinematic lighting. The final look should feel sharp, modern, polished, luxurious, and editorial.

prompts.title: The Weight of the Name
prompts.prompt:
1. Subject and Identity
Subject: A man, approximately 29 years old, in a relaxed yet confident posture.
Identity Source: [Use the uploaded face image as the facial reference, maintaining 100% facial detail and likeness.]
Pose: Full body shot from the side (profile), leaning comfortably against the large white sculpture. Most of the weight is resting on one leg. Both hands comfortably in trouser pockets, creating a natural and effortless look.
Expression: Poignant, thoughtful, and peaceful. The head is slightly tilted as the subject peers through the frame.
2. Wardrobe and Style
Outfit: Comfortable, oversized black round-neck sweatshirt (no logo, soft cotton fabric) paired with ripped jeans.
Footwear: White sneakers with visible shoelaces and distinctive, sculpted soles.
Accessories: Earring piercing.
Style: Monochrome, minimal, and contemporary streetwear/casual fashion.
3. Setting and Environment
Location: Modern, high-end studio environment.
Background: Clean and simple dark grey tones.
Prop/Sculpture: A large, 190 cm tall white sculpture spelling the word "RENO" (in a bold, architectural font). The subject is comfortably leaning against this sculpture.
4. Technical and Aesthetic Details
Angle: Low-angle shot (worm's-eye view) to emphasise height, presence, and the grandeur of the "RENO" sculpture in the background.
Composition: Cinematic and natural proportions. The framing resembles that of a classic portrait lens, with an approximate focal length of 85 mm.
Lighting: Controllable studio lighting. The lighting should strongly and constantly highlight the subject's figure, while casting a soft, directional shadow on the large white sculptural letters behind the subject.
Overall Mood/Vibe: Cinematic, Editorial, and Modern. Combining casual streetwear with distinctive architectural characters.
Realism: Ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed photography (100% realism).
